name: ghidra
description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
one_liner: A free, professional-grade tool that lets you take apart compiled software to see how it works, built and open-sourced by the NSA.
buyer: A security researcher or malware analyst at a cybersecurity firm.
business_use_cases: A malware analysis firm uses it as its core disassembly tool instead of paying for commercial reverse-engineering software.
A security consultancy offers 'binary security audits' for IoT/embedded device makers using it as the core tool.
A bug bounty hunter reverse-engineers closed-source software to find vulnerabilities to report for pay.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid reverse-engineering/security-audit services for hardware and software vendors, using it as the core toolkit.
Build and sell training courses teaching non-experts to use it for security research.

steal_this: Not a weekend build, but a solo security researcher could package a paid binary-audit service offer this week using it as the core tool.
